rawContent: 3. We demand that Mayor @billpeduto make an immediate statement condemning the violence against these Black women @exxonmobil and support the demands for an arrest & protect the protest, as we seek #climate change in #Pittsburgh for Black citizens. #BoycottonBrighton #ShutItDown
